The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the case of an absorbing medium, extinction can be related to the scattering cross section in a straightforward way only in the limit of weak absorption, i.e. when the imaginary part of the refractive index is small compared to the real part.

the extinction of a small particle in a medium can be calculated from the scattering amplitude of the particle by itself in a vacuum, provided that the medium is nonabsorbing and that the particle is much smaller than the wavelength.
